19 static func validate(value: Dictionary, configuration: Dictionary) -> StringName:
  20 	var error:=Config.validate(configuration,true)
  21 	if not error.is_empty():return error
  22 	if not Config.exact(value,KEYS) or typeof(value.version)!=TYPE_INT or value.version!=VERSION or value.protocol_family!=Config.FAMILY or typeof(value.pipeline_protocol_version)!=TYPE_INT or value.pipeline_protocol_version!=L.VERSION or typeof(value.grid_size)!=TYPE_INT or value.grid_size!=256 or value.cell_size_m!=0.125:return &"invalid_unified_checkpoint_header"
  23 	if value.domain_id!=configuration.domain_id or typeof(value.domain_id)!=TYPE_STRING:return &"checkpoint_domain_mismatch"
  24 	for key in ["generation","state_seq","sim_tick","revision","highwater_id","ticket_id","wave_highwater_id"]:
  25 		if not I.counter(value[key],1 if key=="generation" else 0):return &"invalid_checkpoint_counter"
  26 	error=Config.validate(value.configuration)
  27 	if not error.is_empty():return error
  28 	if value.configuration.configuration_hash!=configuration.configuration_hash:return &"checkpoint_configuration_mismatch"
